01 Install

Get ClipDiff for Windows.

Windows 10 (1809+) or Windows 11 · x64

The Windows repository has the current install and update instructions. Extract the whole release ZIP and keep ClipDiff.exe beside ClipDiff.ShellExtension.dll. The self-contained build includes its .NET runtime.

Windows installation instructions ↗/Source on GitHub

02 Use

Copy. Copy. Compare.

  1. 1.Start ClipDiff.exe. It lives in your notification area.
  2. 2.Copy the older text, then copy the newer text.
    You can copy text files too.
  3. 3.Press Ctrl+Alt+D

Or choose Show Diff in the ClipDiff menu. Previous is on the left; current is on the right. Switch between side-by-side and unified views, and use Copy unified diff to copy the unified diff.

ClipDiff captures copies made after it starts. It retains only two captures and does not recover earlier clipboard history.

03 Tricks

A few useful ways to use it.

Compare two config files

Copy one file, then the other in Explorer, and use Show Diff. Or copy exactly two files together to make them the comparison pair. Text files contribute their contents, and the viewer shows their filenames.

Compare copied text with a file

Copy a snippet from a browser or message, then right-click a local file and choose Compare with current ClipDiff capture.

ClipDiff adds the Explorer commands while it is running and Monitor Clipboard is enabled. On Windows 11, look under Show more options.

The command appears once ClipDiff has a current capture. Clearing that capture removes the command; pausing or quitting removes both Explorer commands.

Compare two selected files

Select exactly two files in Explorer, then choose Compare two selected files with ClipDiff. ClipDiff must already be running and monitoring. No previous capture is needed, and no administrator setup is required. On Windows 11, this can be under Show more options.

Use your usual diff viewer

Choose an installed application from Diff viewer in the ClipDiff menu, such as WinMerge, Beyond Compare, Meld, or Visual Studio Code. You can switch back to the built-in viewer at any time.

Supported viewers and setup ↗

Share the difference

Switch to unified view and use Copy unified diff. Paste the diff into an issue or message instead of pasting two complete blocks.

Make it fit your workflow

Choose Keyboard shortcut... to change the shortcut. Turn off Monitor Clipboard to pause capture, or choose Clear Captured Text to discard the two captured values without changing your clipboard.

Comparisons are text-based. Files over 16 MiB are not read; binary or unusable files contribute a filename and reason. Encoding and fallback details.

What happens to the text?

ClipDiff never uploads captures. The built-in viewer keeps them in memory; quitting discards them. External viewers require temporary plaintext files, with a warning before first use and best-effort cleanup.
